android_mechanism: String assembled inefficiently (concatenation) for display; fix builds it efficiently/only what is needed
bug_description: The shared HTTP client logs every successful API response with JSON.stringify(res.result).substring(0, 200): the ENTIRE response object (large question lists, article payloads) is serialized into a string only to keep the first 200 characters. Every API call pays a full-payload serialization plus a substring copy on its completion path.
fix_summary: The log records only the response code and message fields, removing the full-body JSON.stringify and truncation copy.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: blocked on device by fixture reachability; the bench feeds a canned large payload through the same logging path in-app

mechanism_oracle.definition: CPU time spent in the HTTP response handling path per API call (between response receipt and promise resolution visible in JS sampling), averaged over >= 10 calls.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed serializes each full response body (O(payload)); fixed logs O(1) fields. With list payloads of tens of KB, unfixed per-response overhead > fixed.

reproduction: git -C hosts/interviewapp checkout case/interviewapp_response_log_full_stringify/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/interviewapp checkout case/interviewapp_response_log_full_stringify/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
